checks.text: A dependency audit exists and checks the project's locked dependencies: uv run pip-audit with pip-audit in a development dependency group, pip-audit -r on requirements exported from uv.lock, or the PyPA action pointed at the synced environment or at exported requirements. pip-audit with no input outside the project's environment (uvx pip-audit, or pip install pip-audit then pip-audit) fails.

A Slack notification exists and covers every CI job: a job that needs lint, type-check, test, and build; a workflow that runs when the whole CI workflow completes (workflow_run); or a failure step in each of those four jobs.
A Slack notification exists and runs only when CI failed on main.
A Slack notification exists and never runs for pull_request events, nor for a CI run that a pull request started.
The audit runs in its own workflow file, not in ci.yml.
The notification job's timeout is 5 minutes.
The audit runs on pull requests and on a weekly schedule.
The webhook URL is read only as secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.
Every new or changed workflow keeps read-only permissions.
Where the audit job syncs, it uses uv sync --frozen or --locked.

rules.text: - run: uv run pip-audit # audits the synced project environment
`pip-audit` must be in the project's development dependency group for `uv run`
# cannot read secrets, so never notify from pull_request runs.
